headlines.title: 习近平离京出席2026年上海合作组织峰会并对吉尔吉斯斯坦、埃及进行国事访问
headlines.summary: 8月30日上午，国家主席习近平乘专机离开北京，赴比什凯克出席2026年上海合作组织峰会，应吉尔吉斯斯坦总统扎帕罗夫、埃及总统塞西邀请对两国进行国事访问。陪同习近平出访的有：习近平主席夫人彭丽媛，中共中央政治局常委、中央办公厅主任蔡奇，中共中央政治局委员、外交部部长王毅等。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: Xi Jinping Departs for 2026 SCO Summit and State Visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt
headlines.summary_en: On the morning of August 30, President Xi Jinping left Beijing by special plane for Bishkek to attend the 2026 Shanghai Cooperation Organization Summit, and paid state visits to Kyrgyzstan and Egypt at the invitation of Kyrgyz President Japarov and Egyptian President Sisi. Accompanying Xi Jinping were his wife Peng Liyuan, Politburo Standing Committee member and Director of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee Cai Qi, and Politburo member and Foreign Minister Wang Yi, among others. (Xinhua)

headlines.title: 德国财长将在G20会议上就伊朗战争和贸易争端施压
headlines.summary: 德国财政部长Lars Klingbeil计划在与二十国集团（G20）同僚于美国举行的会谈期间，呼吁结束对经济造成损害的冲突，包括关税争端以及伊朗和乌克兰的战争。 兼任德国副总理的Klingbeil在下周一于美国北卡罗来纳州阿什维尔开始的会议前表示：“所有这些都对全球经济发展构成毒害。”他说，减少“全球范围内的巨大不确定性”是每个人的责任，而G20正是明确这一点的合适平台。

headlines.title_en: German Finance Minister to Pressure on Iran War and Trade Disputes at G20 Meeting
headlines.summary_en: German Finance Minister Lars Klingbeil plans to call for an end to economically damaging conflicts, including tariff disputes and the wars in Iran and Ukraine, during talks with G20 counterparts in the US. Klingbeil, who also serves as Vice Chancellor, said ahead of the meetings starting Monday in Asheville, North Carolina: "All of these are toxic to global economic development." He said reducing "the enormous uncertainty worldwide" is everyone's responsibility, and the G20 is the right platform to make this clear.

headlines.summary: 金十数据8月30日讯，德国财政部长克林拜尔计划在美国与G20同行会谈期间，呼吁结束包括关税争端以及伊朗战争和俄乌冲突在内的、对经济造成损害的冲突。兼任德国副总理克林拜尔在下周一于北卡罗来纳州阿什维尔开始的会议前表示：“所有这些都对全球经济发展构成毒害。”他说，减少“全球范围内的巨大不确定性”是所有人的责任，而G20正是明确这一点的合适平台。克林拜尔表示，他还计划在会议期间与包括印度、加拿大和英国在内的国家同行举行会谈，寻求与那些“和我们一样依赖开放且基于规则的贸易、重视可靠性与合作”的国家加强合作。

headlines.title_en: German Finance Minister Plans to Urge End to Tariff Disputes and Regional Conflicts at G20
headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi Data Aug 30 - German Finance Minister Klingbeil plans to call for an end to economically damaging conflicts, including tariff disputes, the Iran war, and the Russia-Ukraine conflict, during talks with G20 counterparts in the US. Klingbeil, who also serves as Vice Chancellor, said ahead of the meetings starting Monday in Asheville, North Carolina: "All of these are toxic to global economic development." He said reducing "the enormous uncertainty worldwide" is everyone's responsibility, and the G20 is the right platform to make this clear. Klingbeil also said he plans bilateral talks with counterparts including India, Canada, and the UK during the meetings, seeking closer cooperation with countries that "like us, rely on open and rules-based trade and value reliability and cooperation."

headlines.title_en: 2026 National Social Science Fund Annual Project Review Meeting Held in Beijing; Li Shulei Attends and Speaks
headlines.summary_en: On August 30, the 2026 National Social Science Fund Annual Project Review Work Conference was held in Beijing. Li Shulei, Politburo member and head of the Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee, attended and delivered a speech. The meeting noted that General Secretary Xi Jinping's important instructions on promoting high-quality development of philosophy and social sciences provide fundamental guidance and clear requirements for thriving development on the new journey. The philosophy and social sciences community should follow Xi's important instructions, deeply study Xi Jinping's cultural thought, grasp the guiding principles, fundamental guarantees, and goals of promoting development, comprehensively advance disciplinary construction, research in all fields, and all aspects of work, and serve the great cause of building a strong country and national rejuvenation with new achievements in high-quality development. The meeting emphasized that Chinese-style modernization provides a rich practical foundation and broad innovation space for high-quality development of philosophy and social sciences.

headlines.title: 隆基绿能：上半年净亏损36.84亿元
headlines.summary: 隆基绿能公告，上半年，国内新增光伏装机阶段性回调，公司实现营业收入270.45亿元，同比下降17.58%。同时，受制于行业供需失衡背景下开工率不足，产品毛利率持续低位，叠加第一季度银价高位推升成本导致的部分集中式订单交付损失，联营企业投资损失及人民币升值带来的汇兑损失等多重影响，报告期内公司实现归属于上市公司股东的净亏损36.84亿元。

headlines.title_en: LONGi Green Energy: Net Loss of 3.684 Billion Yuan in First Half
headlines.summary_en: LONGi Green Energy announced that in H1, domestic new PV installations saw a phased pullback, with revenue reaching RMB 27.045 billion, down 17.58% YoY. Meanwhile, due to low capacity utilization amid industry supply-demand imbalance, persistently low product gross margins, losses on some centralized orders from high silver prices in Q1, investment losses from associates, and FX losses from RMB appreciation, the company recorded a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 3.684 billion for the reporting period.

headlines.title_en: Wang Shao, President of Guangdong Real Estate Industry Association: Completion-Based Sales Model Sharply Raises Industry Entry Barriers, Reshaping Developer Financing Logic
headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi Data Aug 30 - On Aug 28, multiple departments密集 released three major documents focusing on housing sales system reform, real estate credit system restructuring, and capital market support for building a new real estate development model. Measures including prioritizing presale of completed homes for newly transferred land and uniformly raising presale thresholds to main structure completion are seen by the market as landmark signals of fundamental restructuring of the commercial housing presale system. "This is not a simple termination of the presale system, but a systematic reform with categorized optimization and gradual implementation," said Wang Shao, president of the Guangdong Real Estate Industry Association. The new policies, based on the principle of "establishing the new before abolishing the old, advancing stability through progress," coordinate efforts across sales, finance, and capital ends, with the core goal of reducing industry leverage, stripping excessive financial attributes, and returning real estate to its residential essence. headlines.title_en: UAE to Investigate Banque Misr After US Accusation of Iran Links
headlines.summary_en: The UAE central bank said it will investigate Banque Misr after the US Treasury took action to cut off the Egyptian bank's UAE branch from the US financial system as part of sanctions on Iran. The UAE central bank said in a statement it had "decided to conduct a special urgent examination of the bank's transactions during the period of more than two years covered by the US Friday announcement." Its investigation "includes a retrospective forensic/deep review of the period covered by the American authorities' statement, focusing on banking transactions of the companies mentioned in the statement."

headlines.title_en: Xigaze County Landslide Disaster Kills 16, Leaves 546 Missing; Rescue Efforts Accelerated
headlines.summary_en: The Information Office of the Tibet Autonomous Region People's Government held a press conference on the 30th in Gyirong Town, Gyirong County. Karma Tseden, chairman of the autonomous region and commander of the Gyirong County "8-26" mudslide disaster emergency rescue headquarters, said that as of 18:00 on the 29th, the disaster had killed 16 people and left 546 missing. Post-disaster rescue and relief efforts are accelerating. Karma Tseden briefed on four aspects: search and rescue, relocation and resettlement of affected people, hazard investigation, and aftermath handling. Full efforts are being made on search and rescue, with the rapid activation of the regional Level I natural disaster emergency response and Level I disaster relief response, and the establishment of the Gyirong County "8-26" mudslide emergency rescue headquarters and front-line command. On rescue forces and funding, the Ministry of Finance and Ministry of Emergency Management urgently allocated RMB 120 million, and the National Development and Reform Commission arranged RMB 100 million to support rescue and post-disaster recovery.

headlines.title_en: Market for Used New-Energy Vehicles Continues to Heat Up, with Rising Transaction Volumes Across Regions
headlines.summary_en: Since the start of this year, the domestic used car market has been generally stable with slight growth, and new-energy used car transactions have continued to rise. Data from the China Automobile Dealers Association shows that in the first half of this year, used car transaction volumes approached that of new cars, with prices of some used cars roughly half of new ones. The new-energy used car market continued rapid growth, with transaction volume reaching 839,000 units in H1, up 22% YoY, accounting for 8.6% of total used car transactions. Many used car dealers report that new-energy used cars are increasingly favored by consumers, driven by more rational purchasing attitudes and ample market supply. As consumer demand upgrades and supply expands, the internal operating structure of the used car industry is also changing. Various regions have successively introduced favorable policies to optimize used car circulation, supporting the used car market, especially new-energy used cars.

headlines.summary: 今天（30日），西藏吉隆“8·26”泥石流灾害新闻发布会在吉隆镇举行。会上介绍，灾害发生后，西藏迅速启动自治区自然灾害一级应急响应、自治区自然灾害一级救助应急响应，成立吉隆县“8·26”泥石流灾害应急救援指挥部和前方指挥部。财政部、应急管理部紧急拨付1.2亿元资金，国家发改委安排1亿元资金，支持抢险救灾和灾后应急恢复工作。目前，已动员组织解放军、武警、中国消防救援队、边防、公安以及中国安能等各方救援力量2141人，调派救援车辆269辆，救援装备3922套投入一线开展搜救工作。现在，水陆空三路并进挺进受灾核心区。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: Xizang Gyirong press conference: 2,141 rescue personnel mobilized for frontline search and rescue
headlines.summary_en: Today (30th), a press conference on the Gyirong "8-26" mudslide disaster in Tibet was held in Gyirong Town. It was reported that after the disaster, Tibet quickly activated the regional Level I natural disaster emergency response and Level I disaster relief response, establishing the Gyirong County "8-26" mudslide emergency rescue headquarters and front-line command. The Ministry of Finance and Ministry of Emergency Management urgently allocated RMB 120 million, and the National Development and Reform Commission arranged RMB 100 million to support rescue and post-disaster recovery. To date, 2,141 rescue personnel from the PLA, armed police, China Fire and Rescue, border defense, public security, and China Anneng have been mobilized, with 269 rescue vehicles and 3,922 pieces of rescue equipment deployed frontline for search operations. Rescue efforts are now advancing into the affected core area via water, land, and air routes. (CCTV News)

headlines.summary: 8月29日，塞尔维亚首座机器人工厂在该国西部城市沙巴茨正式投产。这座由中塞两国联合建设的工厂，也是欧洲首座人形机器人量产基地。据介绍，这座机器人工厂一期投资额为2000万欧元，占地约3000平方米，主要开展人形机器人和机器狗的组装、运动及视觉系统校准和性能测试。工厂生产的人形机器人未来将首先应用于工业生产，并逐步拓展至教育、公共服务等领域。按照规划，项目后续还将在塞尔维亚建设机器人产业园，计划总投资额约2亿欧元，约合15.6亿元人民币。项目全部建成后，人形机器人和机器狗的年产能预计最高可达2万台，产品将面向欧洲及全球市场。（央视财经）

headlines.title_en: Serbia: Europe's First Humanoid Robot Mass-Production Base Officially Operational, with Annual Capacity Up to 20,000 Units
headlines.summary_en: On August 29, Serbia's first robot factory officially began production in the western city of Sabac. The factory, jointly built by China and Serbia, is also Europe's first mass-production base for humanoid robots. The first-phase investment in the robot factory is EUR 20 million, covering about 3,000 square meters, mainly for assembly of humanoid robots and robot dogs, calibration of motion and vision systems, and performance testing. Humanoid robots produced at the factory will first be applied in industrial production, then gradually expanded to education, public services, and other fields. Under the plan, a robot industrial park will be built in Serbia, with total planned investment of about EUR 200 million, roughly RMB 1.56 billion. Once fully complete, annual production capacity of humanoid robots and robot dogs is expected to reach up to 20,000 units, with products targeting European and global markets. (CCTV Finance)
